optionalFeatures: Assertions that required dashboard entities exist.
Named-range-backed chart series for reusable models.
outcomes: Summary sheets and KPI surfaces are intentionally structured.
Reusable named surfaces back formulas or charts instead of fragile copied ranges.
Charts are authored and then read back through the same contract surface.
requiredInputs: Target persistence path when the dashboard must be saved.
stdout.summary: Assemble an executive dashboard from reusable named surfaces and supported charts.

commonPitfalls: SET_CHART supports the authoritative simple-chart family listed in the protocol catalog.
Chart title and series FORMULA titles must resolve to one cell.
Unsupported loaded chart detail is preserved on unrelated edits but is not available for authoritative mutation.

phases.label: Assemble Summary Sheets
notes: Keep summary layout intentional so later chart anchors are stable.
phases.objective: Create the dashboard canvas and key text or formula cells first.

phases.label: Define Reusable Model Surfaces
notes: Named surfaces reduce accidental drift when the dashboard evolves.
phases.objective: Create named ranges that charts and formulas can depend on.

phases.label: Author And Inspect Visuals
notes: Use factual chart readback to confirm what the workbook now contains.
phases.objective: Create supported charts and verify that the expected entities exist.
